name: Semi-Gradient Method
definition: A neural rendering optimization method that modifies the baseline loss by applying a stop-gradient operation to the RHS term in the numerator, thereby removing the partial derivatives with respect to the RHS to achieve unbiased and low-variance gradient estimates.
summary: The Semi-Gradient Method is a training optimization technique for neural radiance field caching that applies a stop-gradient operation to the rendering equation's right-hand side to eliminate gradient bias and high variance.
